items.html: *And now we shall explain what we have known above concerning the statement of Parashat Tetzaveh, by Moses, "May the name of God be blessed," etc. For behold, during the Ten Days of Repentance the work of the sawing is completed, whose beginning is from the Achoraim of the Keter of ZA, and they are given in the Keter of the Nukva. And this aspect of the sawing of the Keter is done on the first day of Rosh HaShanah; and on this day all the judgments that are in the Keter of the male are given in the Keter of the female.
